segment.description: Station Creek, Claiborne County at Cumberland Gap (TWRA 2026 schedule lists 'Station Creek', Region 4, seasonal rainbow stockings). Upper reach lies in/next to Cumberland Gap National Historical Park; the creek flows to Indian Creek and thence to the Powell River arm of Norris Lake. The NPS water-quality station used for temperature is on the lower creek about 2 km above the mouth.
segment.boundaries: Claiborne County reach from the Cumberland Gap area to the Indian Creek confluence (~36.5886, -83.6049 per catalog hydroIdentity); NPS station CUGA_PM_ST10 at 36.5979, -83.6254.

coldSource.notes: No gauge on the creek (NWIS bounding-box sweep found none); no elevation, spring, or dam evidence found.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. Stocking is seasonal only (weeks of 2/15, 3/1, 3/15, 3/29, 4/12 in 2026, all Rainbow Trout).

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout population documented. Station Creek has no entry on TWRA's trout-regulations page (no wild-trout, special-regulation, or delayed-harvest listing; verified by string search of the live page) and no wild-trout survey record was found. Inside Cumberland Gap NHP the NPS compendium permits fishing in all waters except a closed Davis Branch reach (blackside dace restoration); Station Creek carries no special restriction there.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: NPS summer grab samples 2003-2006 on the lower creek were mostly 15-22 C (marginal but survivable) with a single peak of 23.95 C in Aug 2006, yet stocking is Feb-Apr seasonal only and no wild-trout or holdover evidence exists either way.
